description: A list median follows pushes and pops
code:
waits = [12, 3, 45]
typical = waits.median()
waits.push(7)
assert(typical, 9.5)
waits.pop()
typical

description: A selector takes the median of a property over every instance of a class
code:
class Order(total):
    this.total = total
Order(20)
Order(45)
Order(300)
typical = Order.median(.total)
Order(35)
typical

description: An even count takes the mean of the two middle values in numeric order, and the receiver keeps its order
The median stays at the middle however extreme an outlier is, unlike the mean
An empty list, a class without instances and a value that is not a number give NaN, which Number.isNaN tells apart from null
code:
class Refund
pending = []
[Number.isNaN(pending.median()), Number.isNaN(Refund.median(refund -> refund.amount)), Number.isNaN([1, "x", 3].median()), pending.median() == null]

description: A class-level rule keeps the median rent of each district
code:
class District(name): this.name = name
class Flat(district, rent):
    this.district = district
    this.rent = rent
$District.typical = Flat.filter(flat -> flat.district == $District).median(flat -> flat.rent)
north = District("north")
Flat(north, 1200)
Flat(north, 4000)
Flat(north, 1400)
north.typical
